Lemma
[Regularity of the squared pressure gradient] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0099 ↗ lem:chow-iv-pressure-sobolev-holder 1. ch29:29.8\group Pressure Estimates

For every $p<\infty $ and $\alpha \in (0,1)$, uniformly for $t\le -1$, \[ igl\| | abla v|^2 igr\| _{W^{2,p}}\le C(p),\qquad igl\| | abla v|^2 igr\| _{C^{1,\alpha }}\le C(\alpha ). \]
